title: iRacing MX5 Montreal Guide 1:55.0 Mazda MX5 Circuit Gilles Villeneuve Track Guide

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake at end of concrete section before grass, 65%
corners.line: Turn left, attack left side of corner
corners.exit: Get back on gas at apex, exit wide at 100%

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Brake 70-75% at one marker from two marker
corners.line: Get car turned in, attack curve

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Left tires on track, right tires attacking curve
corners.exit: Flat, left tires touching grass, attack last part to avoid right wall

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: End of white wall section, 90-95% braking, trail off
corners.exit: 100% throttle, slight understeer, lift and get back on gas
corners.mistakes: Brake slightly early to take second corner flat out

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: two marker on left, 80-85% to second gear
corners.line: avoid no-cut curve, left tires left of no-cut curve

corners.braking: two marker on left, 90-100% to first gear

corners.label: T13
corners.mistakes: lift to avoid wall of champions

general_tips: Quarter tank of fuel left, could go faster with more fuel.
Could gain time in final chicane and turns six, seven with better commitment.
